norm: callers shall prevent or coordinate concurrent calls
assumption: Callers shall prevent or coordinate concurrent calls.
rationale: The specification indicates ControlIdle in SWS_Os_00769 as Non Reentrant, but specifies no internal synchronization mechanisms.
